message_body:
Hi Autotech team,

I've attached a short deck for your investment review. GeoCrash helps transportation teams build a reviewable shortlist of roads for engineering investigation, connecting each result to its crash records, exposure assumptions and source data.

The deployed prototype includes 153,273 federal fatal-crash records and a Nebraska engine covering 11,048 road segments. The commercial question is whether it can fit existing engineering workflows and make a paid agency review more useful and reproducible.

I'm exploring pre-seed funding for a first pilot, with no amount set. The deck lays out the data-rights work, validation milestones and current limitations.

Would this fit Autotech's early-stage investment process?

Working product: https://geocrash-666321636483.us-central1.run.app/screening/

Samarpan Mohanty

Hi Cowboy team,

Following your note, I've attached GeoCrash's deck. The starting point is one recurring task: helping a transportation analyst explain which roads warrant engineering review and why.

I've built a public website and API using real federal crash records, with Nebraska road screening and inspectable data sources. My proposed first pilot would test analyst time, engineering usefulness and willingness to pay. I haven't established those outcomes or signed a customer yet.

I'm exploring pre-seed investment to turn the prototype into a validated agency workflow. The deck outlines the milestones and proposed recurring software business; the raise amount is undecided.

Would this be a fit for Cowboy's enterprise investing team?

Live workspace: https://geocrash-666321636483.us-central1.run.app/screening/

Samarpan Mohanty
